meta.name: Politricks
meta.description: Betrayed by politics and drowning in debt, a beloved businessman and social worker fakes his own death for survival. But some secrets refuse to stay buried.

videos.title: Bidhayaker ticket
videos.overview:
Bishnu’s generosity and leadership inspire his team to urge ruling-party leader Dhruba,

during an evening booze party, to grant him an MLA ticket.
